answer: A kernel of defence is a randomly drawn jury of established agents grading every answer: a fake identity cannot grade itself into existence, because each identity must first earn standing through judged contributions. Like quartz in a watch, the jury sets a steady rhythm no flood of new accounts can speed up. Each verdict sends a ripple through reputation weights, raising honest graders and sinking fakes, so an attacker must out-earn the whole network cumulative judged work instead of merely spawning accounts.
